global.description: Global values, shared with parent charts.

imageRegistry.description: Registry for every image (a mirror or pull-through cache); overrides each image's registry.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for every component (e.g. Asia/Shanghai); sets TZ and PHP's date.timezone. Empty keeps UTC.

namespaceOverride.description: Namespace for all resources; empty uses the release namespace.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full resource name prefix.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for all pods.

name.description: ServiceAccount name; defaults to the release's full name, or "default" when create=false.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the API token into pods; no component needs it.

repository.description: Image repository, without the registry (one that starts with a registry host is used as-is).

digest.description: Image digest (sha256:...) to pin a build; used together with the tag.

replicaCount.description: App replicas. Install with 1; more than 1 needs a ReadWriteMany volume.

podAntiAffinity.description: Spread replicas across nodes. Ignored when app.affinity is set.

autoscaling.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler for the app (needs metrics-server); replaces replicaCount.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Average CPU utilization target (% of requests); empty disables.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Average memory utilization target (% of requests); empty disables.

pdb.description: PodDisruptionBudget, created only when more than one replica must run.

type.description: Recreate for ReadWriteOnce volumes, RollingUpdate for ReadWriteMany.

persistence.description: Storage for the kodbox site and user files, mounted at /var/www/html.

enabled.description: Persist the kodbox site and user files on a PersistentVolumeClaim; false uses an emptyDir.

storageClass.description: Storage class; empty uses the cluster default.

size.description: Volume size for the kodbox site and user files.

existingClaim.description: Use an existing PersistentVolumeClaim instead of creating one.

annotations.description: Extra PVC annotations, e.g. for pvc-autoresizer.

waitForDependencies.description: Wait for the database and redis to accept connections before starting kodbox.

resources.description: Kubernetes resource requests and limits for the app.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes on the app pod, e.g. a ConfigMap overriding nginx.conf or php-fpm's www.conf.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts on the app container, pairing with app.extraVolumes.

nodeSelector.description: Node labels for scheduling the app.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for the app pods.

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations for the app pods.

podLabels.description: Extra labels for the app pods.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for the app pods; a missing labelSelector is filled with the pod's labels.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the the app container.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe override for the app, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe override for the app, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

startupProbe.description: Startup probe override for the app, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context for the app pods.

securityContext.description: Container security context for the app containers.

admin.description: Initial kodbox admin account, applied only on the very first start.

bootstrap.description: Create the admin account on first start; false lets the first visitor create it.

password.description: Admin password; empty generates one. 8+ characters using 3 of digits, upper, lower and ~!@#$%^&*; no " $ ` or \.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret with KODBOX_ADMIN_USER and KODBOX_ADMIN_PASSWORD.

database.description: Database credentials shared by the db and app containers.

rootPassword.description: Database root password; empty generates one.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret with MYSQL_DATABASE, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD and MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.

db.description: Bundled MariaDB. Set enabled=false and fill externalDatabase to use your own.

repository.description: Image repository, without the registry (one that starts with a registry host is used as-is).

digest.description: Image digest (sha256:...) to pin a build; used together with the tag.

persistence.description: Storage for MariaDB data, mounted at /var/lib/mysql.

storageClass.description: Storage class; empty uses the cluster default.

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC instead of the StatefulSet's volume; new installs only.

resources.description: Kubernetes resource requests and limits for MariaDB.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for MariaDB pods; a missing labelSelector is filled with the pod's labels.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the MariaDB container.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe override for MariaDB, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe override for MariaDB, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

startupProbe.description: Startup probe override for MariaDB, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context for MariaDB pods.

securityContext.description: Container security context for MariaDB containers.

backup.description: Scheduled mariadb-dump of the kodbox database onto a dedicated volume.

enabled.description: Create the backup CronJob and volume. Off by default; see README for WaitForFirstConsumer storage.

schedule.description: Cron schedule, in timezone when set (else UTC).

extraArgs.description: Extra mariadb-dump options, e.g. --skip-ssl for an external server without TLS.

image.description: Image with mariadb-dump; empty fields fall back to db.image.

persistence.description: Storage for database dumps, mounted at /backup.

storageClass.description: Storage class; empty uses the cluster default.

existingClaim.description: Use an existing PersistentVolumeClaim instead of creating one.

startingDeadlineSeconds.description: How late a run may start.

resources.description: Kubernetes resource requests and limits for backups.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for backup pods; a missing labelSelector is filled with the pod's labels.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the backup container.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe override for backup, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe override for backup, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

startupProbe.description: Startup probe override for backup, merged over the chart default; enabled: false removes it.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context for backup pods.

securityContext.description: Container security context for backup containers.

externalRedis.description: External Redis, used when redis.enabled=false. Empty host disables Redis. Applied on kodbox's first start only; must listen on 6379.

existingSecretKey.description: Key of the password in existingSecret.

kodoffice.description: Document server (kodoffice or upstream ONLYOFFICE). Browsers load it directly, so it needs a user-reachable URL.

edition.description: kodoffice: kodcloud's ONLYOFFICE 7.4 build. onlyoffice: upstream ONLYOFFICE Document Server (onlyoffice.image).
